name: side-project-launch
description: Work-heavy: user has a half-built SaaS and wants to ship it. Personal goals should still be present and not be 'work-adjacent' filler.
initial_prompt: I've been building a SaaS side project for like six months and it's 80% done but I keep finding new things to add instead of shipping it. I want to actually launch it in the next sprint. I'm doing this on nights and weekends — my day job is unrelated.
scripted_user_replies: Realistic remaining work: billing integration, a landing page, and onboarding emails. The product itself is solid. The thing that's holding me back is honestly fear that nobody will care once it's live.

Two weeks is right — that matches my own ship deadline. For accountability, I post in a Twitter/X build-in-public thread already. My partner is also patient about evening work but I should not have her be the accountability person.
